source.text_it: Il termostato dell'impianto di raffreddamento può essere attivato dal conducente per mezzo di un interruttore che si trova sul cruscotto

records.localized_text: The driver may activate the cooling thermostat with a dashboard switch.

source.text_it: Scopo fondamentale dello pneumatico è quello di assicurare l’aderenza ruota-strada

records.localized_text: A tire's main purpose is to ensure wheel-to-road grip.

source.text_it: Lo pneumatico agisce insieme alle sospensioni per il molleggio del veicolo

records.localized_text: A tire works with the suspension to cushion the vehicle.

source.text_it: Entro i limiti dell’aderenza, lo pneumatico assicura la trasmissione al suolo della forza motrice

records.localized_text: Within grip limits, a tire transmits driving force to the ground.

source.text_it: Entro i limiti dell’aderenza, lo pneumatico assicura la trasmissione al suolo della forza frenante

records.localized_text: Within grip limits, a tire transmits braking force to the ground.

source.text_it: Lo pneumatico evita che il peso del veicolo gravante sulla strada danneggi il manto stradale

records.localized_text: A tire prevents vehicle weight on the road from damaging the road surface.

source.text_it: Entro i limiti dell’aderenza, lo pneumatico permette di dirigere il veicolo nella direzione impostata dal conducente

records.localized_text: Within grip limits, a tire allows the vehicle to follow the driver's chosen direction.

source.text_it: Il battistrada dello pneumatico ha la funzione di drenare l’acqua, eventualmente presente sulla carreggiata, dall’area di impronta del battistrada

records.localized_text: Tire tread drains water from the contact patch when water is present on the road.

source.text_it: Lo pneumatico deve essere il più rigido possibile

records.localized_text: A tire must be as rigid as possible.

source.text_it: Durante la stagione fredda, lo pneumatico deve essere fatto scaldare alcuni minuti prima della partenza

records.localized_text: In cold weather, tires must be warmed for several minutes before departure.

source.text_it: Una spia rossa posta sul cruscotto avverte l’autista quando lo pneumatico deve essere sostituito

records.localized_text: A red dashboard warning light tells the driver when a tire must be replaced.

source.text_it: Acquistando nuovi pneumatici con mescola più morbida del set precedente, occorre irrigidire gli ammortizzatori

records.localized_text: When buying tires with a softer compound than the previous set, the shock absorbers must be stiffened.

source.text_it: L’aderenza ruota-strada non dipende dallo stato d’usura degli pneumatici

records.localized_text: Wheel-to-road grip does not depend on tire wear.

source.text_it: Se, con un veicolo pesante, si devono affrontare salite di pendenza superiore al 15%, occorre montare pneumatici rinforzati

records.localized_text: A heavy vehicle facing gradients over 15% must have reinforced tires.

source.text_it: Non si può circolare in autostrada con veicoli che montano pneumatici ricostruiti

records.localized_text: Vehicles with retreaded tires may not use motorways.

source.text_it: La ruota è composta da disco e cerchio

records.localized_text: A wheel consists of a disc and rim.

source.text_it: Sul cerchio è riportata una sigla che permette di ricavarne le principali caratteristiche

records.localized_text: The rim bears a code identifying its main characteristics.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sul cerchio si può ricavarne la larghezza

records.localized_text: The code on the rim reveals its width.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sul cerchio si può ricavare il tipo di profilo della balconata

records.localized_text: The code on the rim reveals the flange profile type.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sul cerchio si può ricavarne il diametro di calettamento

records.localized_text: The code on the rim reveals its mounting diameter.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sul cerchio si può ricavarne l’OFF-SET

records.localized_text: The code on the rim reveals its offset.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sullo pneumatico si può ricavarne l’anno e la settimana di fabbricazione

records.localized_text: The code on the tire reveals its year and week of manufacture.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sul cerchio si può ricavarne il giorno di fabbricazione dello pneumatico

records.localized_text: The code on the rim reveals the day the tire was made.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sul cerchio si può ricavarne la data in cui deve essere revisionato lo pneumatico

records.localized_text: The code on the rim reveals the date the tire must be inspected.

source.text_it: Dalla sigla riportata sul cerchio si può ricavarne l'anno di scadenza dello pneumatico

records.localized_text: The code on the rim reveals the tire's expiry year.

rows.text: The thermostat automatically regulates coolant flow to the radiator according to temperature; it is not operated by a dashboard switch.
evidence: https://www.valeoservice.co.uk/en-uk/lcv/cooling-and-air-management-lcv/thermostats — apertura alla temperatura prevista e flusso al radiatore.

rows.text: The tire’s contact patch with the road develops the forces needed to steer, accelerate and brake.
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: The tire deforms and cushions road irregularities, contributing to the vehicle’s springing along with the suspension.
evidence: https://thetiredigest.michelin.com/performance-noise-and-comfort — pneumatico flessibile attenua gli urti delle irregolarità.

rows.text: Driving force passes to the road through the tire’s contact patch; the wheel slips if available grip is exceeded.
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: Braking force passes to the road through the tire’s contact patch, within the available grip limit.
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: The quiz marks this VERO: the tire carries the load through a deformable contact patch, spreading contact over the road. This can reduce concentrated loading, but it does not guarantee the pavement cannot be damaged; heavy loads also wear it.
evidence: https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/policy/otps/truck/wusr/chap04.cfm — FHWA: l’interazione pneumatico-carico incide sul deterioramento del manto.

https://cdn.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — Continental p.7 PDF locale visualizzato: impronta e sostegno del carico; distribuzione del contatto è inferenza fisica.

rows.text: Lateral forces developed in the contact patch allow the vehicle to follow the intended direction until available grip is exceeded.
evidence: Continental, White Paper Tires for Commercial Vehicles, printed/PDF p. 7, https://www.continental.com/fileadmin/__imported/sites/corporate/_international/english/hubpages/10_20press/01_press_releases/06_20cvt/001_white_papers_cvt/white_paper_tires_for_commercial_vehicles.pdf — road contact supplies traction, braking grip and lateral guidance; inspected complete local copy /tmp/rotonda-continental-commercial-tyres.pdf SHA256 fa6f57201027b16116e1958bd2d8be687633ef83627025b13d352191b4a695a6.

rows.text: Tread grooves collect and move water away from the contact patch, helping maintain contact with a wet road.
evidence: https://middle-east.michelin.com/auto/en/advice/change-tyres/how-long-do-tyres-last — il battistrada raccoglie e scarica acqua.

rows.text: A tire must be able to deform: its elasticity helps absorb irregularities and maintain road contact.
evidence: https://thetiredigest.michelin.com/performance-noise-and-comfort — deformazione, aderenza e attenuazione degli urti.

rows.text: Tires do not need to be warmed before setting off. Instead, check their pressure cold according to the vehicle’s instructions.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — controllo della pressione a pneumatici freddi secondo la prescrizione del veicolo.

rows.text: A pressure warning indicates low pressure, not that a tire needs replacing. Wear and damage must be checked directly.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — TPMS rileva pressione bassa; controllare usura e danni.

rows.text: A softer compound does not require the shock absorbers to be stiffened. Replacement tires must match the vehicle’s specifications.
evidence: https://africa.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/choose-tyres/choose-tyres-for-my-car — scelta secondo dimensioni e specifiche del veicolo; nessuna regolazione degli ammortizzatori prescritta.

rows.text: Wear reduces groove depth and can impair wet grip, increasing the risk of aquaplaning.
evidence: https://africa.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/change-tyres/tyre-wear-indicator — battistrada poco profondo e perdita di aderenza sul bagnato.

rows.text: The stated gradient does not itself require reinforced tires: the choice must meet the vehicle’s specifications and required load capacity.
evidence: Continental Truck, Bus & Trailer Tire Product Data Guide 2025, https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/us/truck/literature/catalogs/TT-CO-BK-DATA.pdf — tire selection matched to axle loads and load/inflation tables; supports necessary load capacity, not proof that no special operating rule could exist.

rows.text: Approved retreaded tires suitable for the vehicle can also be used on motorways; retreading does not entail a general ban.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A42026X0308 — regolamento ONU 109, omologazione pneumatici ricostruiti per veicoli commerciali.
https://www.continental-tires.com/us/en/about-us/newsroom/truck-and-bus/contitread-hdl-5-ep/ — esempio di ricostruito progettato per lunghe percorrenze autostradali.

rows.text: In a disc wheel, the disc connects the wheel to the hub and the rim supports the tire.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, ruota a disco composta da cerchio e disco.

rows.text: The rim designation identifies its dimensions and construction, helping select a compatible tire.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, esempio di designazione e compatibilità.

rows.text: In the rim designation, the width is the distance between the flanges, not the tire width.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, larghezza nella designazione del cerchio.

rows.text: A letter in the designation, such as J, identifies the rim flange profile type.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, J indica il tipo di balconata.

rows.text: The rim designation includes the nominal diameter where the tire bead fits; the diameters must be compatible.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, diametro del cerchio e necessaria corrispondenza con pneumatico.

rows.text: The ET marking indicates offset: the distance between the rim’s center plane and the disc’s mounting face at the hub.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, ET e definizione di offset.

rows.text: The date code on the tire sidewall indicates its week and year of manufacture, not an expiry date.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/calendarwk23070 — codice TIN indica settimana e anno.

rows.text: The rim code describes the rim. The date code on the tire sidewall gives the week and year of manufacture, not the exact day.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/calendarwk23070 — codice sullo pneumatico indica settimana e anno.
https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, marcatura del cerchio.

rows.text: The rim code identifies rim characteristics, not a tire inspection date; wear and damage must be checked regularly.
evidence: https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, dati identificativi del cerchio.
https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — ispezioni periodiche per usura e danni.

rows.text: The rim code describes the rim, not the tire’s expiry year. The sidewall code indicates when the tire was made.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — TIN sul fianco indica settimana e anno di fabbricazione.
https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf — p. 29, designazione del cerchio.

source_inspection.source: Continental 2025 Truck, Bus & Trailer Tire Product Data Guide
source_inspection.finding: Inspected full 120-page PDF locally; printed p.96 (PDF p.97) tabulates tyre load limits by cold inflation pressure, size and single/dual fitment. Supports load-capacity selection; does not establish absence of every possible special rule.

issues.reason: Il quesito stampa VERO per l’affermazione che lo pneumatico evita che il peso del veicolo danneggi il manto stradale, senza condizioni. La fonte tecnica indica invece che carichi su ruote e assi possono causare danni alla pavimentazione. Non è chiarito se il quesito intenda soltanto una riduzione del contatto diretto o dei danni superficiali: tale portata non è espressa nel testo.
checked_sources: Quiz ufficiale superiori, PDF SHA-256 a8bb47ac18788c151ba4596b4095221a4a2fce6f2cb026ffe671cf8283df9234, pagina 123 (indice 122), n. 29941: affermazione e risposta VERO stampata.
https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/research/infrastructure/pavements/13038/007.cfm — sezione Traffic Loads: i carichi delle ruote e degli assi possono danneggiare la pavimentazione.
https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/policy/otps/truck/wusr/chap04.cfm — Truck-Pavement Interaction: il deterioramento dipende dai carichi sugli assi e anche dal numero e dalla larghezza degli pneumatici.
